┌─ Help: The map and its legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Legend                                                                       │
│   You       @ you  % scout marker  + plan end  ◄ objective                   │
│   People    p player  T trainer  $ vendor  B banker  H binder  g guard       │
│             Q quest person  & board  D door                                  │
│   Quest     ! new  ? hand in  ? in progress  m quest mob  D next door        │
│   Events    ; scout point  v raiders appear  ◆ raiders head for              │
│   Creatures m mob  M target  x dead  r rare  * loot  ~ not yours  c camp     │
│   Ground    # building  ^ rock  ≈ water  : ford  = bridge  " forest  · road  │
│             . floor  ░ zone edge                                             │
│                                                                              │
│ Marks and pointers                                                           │
│   Gold is the quest's alone. A gold ! is somebody with something new for     │
│   you; a gold ? is a hand-in that is ready, a grey ? a quest in progress. A  │
│   board that has something to take or hand in is gold. Mobs that count for a │
│   contract you hold are gold, and the next door on your way is a gold D.     │
│   Shape says it as well as colour.                                           │
│   World events and scouting have their own marks. The scout points (;) are   │
│   gold, as your own scout marker (%) is. A world event's raiders appear at a │
│   purple v and head for a purple ◆. Hover over any of them for its name, or  │
│ Page 2 of 10  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
